summary: First iteration full-stack testing for Freres Global marketing site. Backend (6/6 pytest tests) and frontend (hero, 6 product cards, all sections, lenis smooth scroll, contact form submission with DB persistence, mobile menu open/close) all passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Inquiry submitted via the UI was persisted in MongoDB and visible via GET /api/inquiries.

issues: Masked line-by-line reveal removes inter-line spaces so screen-reader / copy text reads 'Enterprise hardware,delivered withsurgical precision.' (no spaces at line boundaries). Cosmetic/a11y nit only — visually renders correctly.

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: Note that the contact form uses data-testids input-name/input-email/input-company/input-message/submit-inquiry and interest-{slug} (not the contact-name/contact-email/interest-chip-{slug} named in the review request). Functionality is complete; only naming diverges from spec — align if strict spec adherence needed.
OPTIONAL: Add a whitespace between hero mask lines so copied/screen-reader text has word separation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo then parses back — works, but consider storing as native BSON datetime for indexed sort correctness at scale.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handler.
CORS is wide open ('*') with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentialed requests when origin is '*', so this is effectively fine for a public marketing API but worth tightening for prod.
seed_data_creation: Test inquiries created via API and UI with TEST_ prefixed names and @freresglobal-test.com emails. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoint) — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://systems-hub-7.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend fully passing. Frontend testids differ from review spec inside the contact form (input-name, input-email, input-company, input-message, submit-inquiry, interest-<slug>) — use these when writing playwright. Lenis smooth scroll works via clicking [data-testid=nav-link-contact]. Mobile menu: nav-mobile-toggle opens, mobile-menu-close closes.
